_comment: Slower than it should be (notes/strange-words-plan.md 4). `pace` is one name on the rain, a shifting sky
and the creatures, so `slow weather` lets the rain drift down at a fraction of its speed and patter lower --
the slow-rain step, written on purpose -- `slow shifting sky` takes a day over each colour, and `slow monsters`
crawl while everything else walks, and `slow sun` makes the day twice as long -- the first sun's pace is the
Age's clock. A slow Age is all of them. `swift` is the other end of the same axis.
